import importlib.util,random,time,itertools
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('m','/workspace/submission/main.py');m=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec);spec.loader.exec_module(m)

def brute(benefits,item_nodes,caps):
    n=len(benefits);bestv=-1;bestc=10**9;bm=0
    for mask in range(1<<n):
        u=[0]*len(caps);v=c=0;ok=True
        for i in range(n):
            if mask>>i&1:
                c+=1;v+=benefits[i]
                for k in item_nodes[i]:
                    u[k]+=1
                    if u[k]>caps[k]:ok=False;break
                if not ok:break
        if ok and (v>bestv or (v==bestv and c<bestc)):
            bestv=v;bestc=c;bm=mask
    return bestv,bestc,bm

def check(n,dims,trials):
  for t in range(trials):
    caps=[random.randint(0,n) for _ in range(dims)]
    item_nodes=[]
    for i in range(n):
        L=random.randint(1,min(9,dims))
        item_nodes.append(random.sample(range(dims),L))
    if t%3==0: benefits=[random.randint(1,5) for _ in range(n)]
    elif t%3==1: benefits=[random.randint(1,10**9) for _ in range(n)]
    else: benefits=[1]*n
    got=m._planner_solve(benefits,item_nodes,caps,n)
    gv,gc,sel=got
    # returned selected list only when not aborted? function returns selected list always
    # reconstruct from sel
    v=sum(benefits[i] for i in sel);c=len(sel)
    u=[0]*dims
    for i in sel:
        for k in item_nodes[i]:u[k]+=1
    if any(u[k]>caps[k] for k in range(dims)):
        print('INFEASIBLE SELECT',t,caps,item_nodes,benefits,(gv,gc,sel));return False
    exp=brute(benefits,item_nodes,caps)
    if (v,c)!=(exp[0],exp[1]):
        print('MISMATCH',n,dims,t,caps,item_nodes,benefits,(gv,gc,sel,v,c),exp[:2],bin(exp[2]));return False
  print('passed',n,dims,trials);return True

random.seed(123)
for n,d in [(16,15),(18,20),(20,10)]:
    if not check(n,d,100 if n<=18 else 10):break
else: print('all normal')
# fallback forced all cases
m.B_ABORT_CALLS=1
for n,d in [(16,15),(18,20)]:
    if not check(n,d,100):break
else: print('all fallback')
# full n22 some brute

for t in range(3):
    n=22;d=22;caps=[random.randint(0,8) for _ in range(d)]
    item_nodes=[];benefits=[]
    for i in range(n):
        L=random.randint(1,9);item_nodes.append(random.sample(range(d),L));benefits.append(random.randint(1,1000))
    st=time.perf_counter();gv,gc,sel=m._planner_solve(benefits,item_nodes,caps,n);dt=time.perf_counter()-st
    exp=brute(benefits,item_nodes,caps)
    print('n22',t,dt,(gv,gc),exp[:2], 'ok',sum(benefits[i] for i in sel)==exp[0] and len(sel)==exp[1])
